# Catalogue · Ecosystem Map

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/catalogo>. Author: **Mauricio Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-01-15 · Updated: 2026-06-21.

## How the catalog is organized

It is not a list, it is a journey on five pillars — Mentality → Method → Application → Value → Results. Each content is a node of a network that leads from mentality to result, going through the method, its application in Salesforce and support in production.

## 01 · Mentality — Foundation

Principles of systemic thinking and knowledge management: the starting point before any tool.

- [Navigating in Complexity](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/know) — the Cynefin Framework and the end of best practices: leading innovation and emerging processes in complex environments.
- [Vibe Coding with Devin](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/devin) — engineering in practice: Devin as an executor of engineering tasks, from the intention to code.
- [Problem Formulation](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/formulacao-de-problemas) — formulating is uncertainty reduction engineering, and needs to stop: six uncertainties, six states of knowledge, stop rule and the hyper-resolution penaltyr.
- [Capacity Before Access](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/capacidade-antes-do-acesso) — teaching competence, pedagogical mediation and governance of the IA in early childhood education and fundamental.
- [The Invisible Artificer](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/artifice) — the paradox of technical mastery: why sophistication becomes invisible burden, and how to regain the sovereignty of craft.
- [Curiosity and Research](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/curiosidade-e-investigacao) — information is not knowledge: transform curiosity into investigation using AI as a bench, not as an oracle.

## 02 · The Method — Trust Engineering

From intention to reliable agentic execution: the discipline-bridge that transforms mentality into method.

- [Auditable AI architecture](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/apresentacao) — GraphRAG, Spec-Driven Development and DevOps Salesforce in two readings: executive (risk and return) and engineering (coverage and latency).
- [Trust Engineering](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/engenharia-confianca) — four modules connecting Reverse Engineering, Agent Engineering and Vibe Coding.
- [AI Agent Engineering](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/engenharia-agentes-ia) — the ten principles that make AI systems reliable: little AI on the critical path, contracts, FinOps and Agent-Driven governance.
- [Operation Cognitive Capital](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/operacao-capital-cognitivo) — IA FinOps executive simulator and the Userful Intelligence per Dollar framework (UI/$).
- [Agent Ready](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/agent-ready) — how to make a website readable, findable and usable by AI agents, with the actual code of this domain.
- [Case Agents](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/case-agents) — Queries routing and secure selection of tools in a banking agent: 4-layer pre-execution barrier and Silent Crash control.
- [Knowledge OS Enterprise](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/knowledge-os-presentation) — the knowledge system that gives traceability and security to AI.

## 03 · Application — Salesforce Ecosystem

Agentic methods applied to the Salesforce platform: where the method finds real engineering.

- [DevOps Salesforce](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/devops-salesforce) — continuous agency delivery uniting Flosum governance, GitHub flexibility and AI speed.
- [Reverse Engineering Assisted by AI](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta-engenharia-reversa) — the Salesforce code inherited to the live specification without manual refactor.
- [Quick Start: Salesforce + Devin + Flosum](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/salesforce-agentic-quickstart) — set up the agentic development environment and make the first deploy governed.
- [Agent DevOps for Salesforce](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/salesforce-agentic-dev) — Spec-Driven Development training portal and autonomous agents.

## 04 · Value — Support & Resilience

Service operation, SRE and resilience in production: where the delivered engineering proves itself over time.

- [From Chaos to Resilience](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/sustentacao) — critical incident management, reliability (SRE) and effective communication in crisis.
- [Service Operations 2.0](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/service-operations-2-0) — the Manchester Protocol applied to IT, for systemic resilience and billing protection.
- [Sales Intelligence: Salesforce + AWS](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta) — real-time sales intelligence via event-driven architecture.
- [RES observability for Mobility](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta-observabilidade-mobile) — correlation between devices, network and applications with Datadog and Azure.

## 05 · Results — Solutions & Portfolio

Solutions delivered and the personal journey: the destination of the network, where the method becomes a result.

- [SocialSelling](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/socialselling) — good practice model for social sales enhanced by AI agents.
- [Mauricio Yokoyama Issei](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/) — the professional trajectory and starting point of the ecosystem.
